QuestInfo.name: [Icy Onslaught] Edelstein's Barrier Generator
QuestInfo.0: Warn #p2152000# of the impending Frost Fiends invasion of #bEdelstein#k.
QuestInfo.1:
You warned #p2152000# that the Frost Fiends plan to invade #bEdelstein#k, but #p2152000# didn't seem worried. Apparently, the Resistance has some kind of #bBarrier Generator#k to keep the Frost Fiends out. However, as the device is still a prototype, it must be activated manually.

#p2152000# asks you to power up Edelstein's #bBarrier Generator#k since you're already there.
Interact with the #p9400370# in the center of Edelstein for a #bmanual#k on starting the #bBarrier Generator#k.
Start the #bBarrier Generator#k and talk to #p2152000#.
